notes.title: RedFox Network System Maintenance on Tuesday, February 21st, 2017 at 5:00PM (17:00) PDT.
notes.content:
Hi Karos Community,

RedFox will be having a Network System Maintenance for All RedFox Games on Tuesday, February 21st, 2017 starting at 5:00PM (17:00) PDT. Please be aware the servers will be down and that you will not be able to log in game during maintenance. Please understand that players will not be able to access the game servers, website, and forums during this time. RedFox Network System Maintenance is expected to last 1 - 2 hours

We will keep everyone updated on when maintenance is over. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Thank you for your support and patience.

RedFox

notes.title: Karos Returns is Now Live on Steam!
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We are excited to announce that Karos Returns is now back on Steam! RedFox Games have re-acquired the publishing rights for the Karos Returns on Steam. Karos Returns is now once again live on Steam with a new game client available for download. Would you like to be able to use Steam Overlay to chat with your friends while playing Karos Returns? Here is your chance, log into your Steam Account, and come join us.

Thank you for all your continued support we hope that you enjoy playing Karos Returns on Steam!

https://www.playredfox.com/karos

RedFox Games
